text:
**Yes—Monzo is a UK-authorised bank, and eligible money in its standard bank accounts is protected if it fails.** FSCS cover is up to **£120,000 per person, per authorised bank** for failures from 1 December 2025. That cap applies to the total of your eligible deposits with Monzo, not each account separately. If you also hold money at another bank that shares Monzo’s banking licence, those deposits may count towards the same limit.

FSCS usually pays eligible deposit claims automatically, typically within seven days. Amounts above the limit may not be protected. Some products have different rules: for example, investment losses aren’t covered just because the investment falls in value.

“Safe” can also mean protection from scams or account problems—FSCS cover doesn’t reimburse every kind of loss. Keep your account details secure and contact Monzo promptly if something seems wrong.

Sources: [FSCS deposit limits](https://www.fscs.org.uk/deposit-limit/) · [Monzo’s safety information](https://monzo.com/learn/money-safety/how-we-help-protect-your-money)
